title: Price Fixer known shops
description: Known shopping sites: the popup badge name and optional price selectors scanned before the rest of the page. The first matching shop wins. Loaded by src/sites/shops.ts.

domains.description: "shop.com" matches shop.com and its subdomains. "shop.*" matches the shop under any country suffix (shop.de, shop.co.uk, smile.shop.com).

priceSelectors.description: CSS selectors for price elements on this shop. Scanned first; the full-page scan still runs afterwards.

skipSelectors.description: Elements that look like prices but aren't (ratings, review counts). Price selectors inside them are ignored.

pageIndicators.description: Selectors that identify the shop on any domain (e.g. a Shopify store on its own domain). Checked only when no shop matches by domain.
